title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive - Construction Property Professional Indemnity

Overview:

As a Business Development Executive, you will proactively engage with mid-market and SME businesses across the UK, with a particular focus on clients within the construction and property professional services sector. This includes organisations such as surveyors, architects, design and planning consultancies, and engineering firms across all disciplines. You will help clients understand how you / our client can support their insurance needs, gaining valuable experience in identifying risk exposures, discussing tailored insurance solutions, and promoting end-to-end service-from initial consultation through to long-term partnership.

Your role will be central to expanding our clients client base and supporting our mission to deliver exceptional, specialist-led insurance solutions. Whether you are advising a local professional practice or supporting the placement of more complex programmes for growing and internationally active firms, your contribution will play a key role in driving continued growth.

Responsibilities:

Proactively contact prospective clients to introduce, gather relevant insurance information, and support negotiations with both clients and insurers.

Identify, research, and develop new sources of prospective clients to help expand presence and market reach.

Work closely with brokers and account handlers to support the onboarding and development of potential new clients.

Accurately maintain client and prospect records on our CRM systems, ensuring all information is recorded promptly and kept up to date in line with company standards.

Build a strong foundation of Professional Indemnity Insurance knowledge, including working towards and achieving CII insurance qualifications.

Actively participate in structured training and development programmes focused on building the core skills required for success in the role.

Contribute as part of a fast-paced, collaborative, and continually evolving environment, with significant opportunities for learning and professional growth.

Requirements:

Previous experience within the insurance market and sales.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Our clients team thrives on effective communication and the ability to work together towards common goals.

Sales and negotiation skills that will help you compete in a fast-paced market.

Strong motivation and ambition in progressing your career in insurance.

An eye for detail to ensure that all records and client interactions are meticulously managed and maintained.

title: Business Development Executive
company: Perfect Placement Uk Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are pleased to present an exciting opportunity for a Local Business Development Executive at a reputable dealership in Manchester. Our client is seeking a motivated and experienced professional to join their dynamic team, playing a key role in expanding the local business and fleet customer base.

Benefits for the successful Business Development Executive:
- Competitive basic salary of £37,000 per annum, with an OTE of approximately £60,000 through a generous bonus scheme
- Company car and fuel card to support your mobility and flexibility
- 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday
- 33 days holiday inclusive of bank holidays, with options for holiday purchase or sale
- Pension scheme and life assurance for long-term security
- Vehicle purchase and service discount schemes
- Access to additional benefits, including wellbeing programs, community schemes, volunteer days, cycle to work schemes, and employee discounts

Duties of the Business Development Executive:
- Develop and actively grow the local business and fleet customer database within the Manchester area
- Promote a comprehensive range of vehicles, including new and used passenger cars and commercial vehicles, as well as aftersales and parts services
- Manage and close sales deals with existing clients while proactively identifying new business opportunities
- Demonstrate exceptional customer service and product knowledge to provide tailored, consultative solutions
- Work independently to achieve and surpass sales targets, while contributing to the success of the team
- Build and maintain professional relationships from initial contact through to the finalisation of sales

Requirements of the Business Development Executive:
- A minimum of 2 years' sales experience, preferably within the automotive industry
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills
- Self-motivated with the initiative to work independently
- Proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a fast-paced environment
- Excellent relationship management skills from first contact through to closing deals

If you are a dedicated sales professional with a passion for the motor trade and are seeking to progress your career in automotive sales, we invite you to explore this opportunity further.

Contact Sam Tinkler, Automotive Recruitment Specialist at Perfect Placement covering Stockport and Manchester, today to discover more about this excellent Business Development Executive position.

At Perfect Placement we specialise in Jobs within the Automotive Field, we can help you with your Career search for Motor Trade Jobs as we have over 1,700 live Automotive Vacancies across the whole of the UK ranging from Vehicle Technician Jobs to Business Development Executive Jobs.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
£30,000 - £38,000 DOE basic + uncapped commission (OTE £70,000)

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an ambitious and driven Business Development Executive to join a growing business based in Manchester. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys sales, building relationships, and working in a fast-paced, target-driven environment with strong earning potential and clear progression opportunities.

You will play a key role in generating new business, developing client relationships, and supporting growth across multiple sectors. If you are confident on the phone, motivated by targets, and looking to build a successful career in sales, this could be the perfect next step.

Company Benefits:
- Competitive basic salary with uncapped commission structure.
- Realistic OTE of £70,000
- Clear progression opportunities within a growing business.
- Supportive and energetic team environment.
- Company pension scheme.
- Free parking.
- Regular incentives, team events, and rewards.
- Ongoing training and mentoring.

Key Responsibilities:
- Proactively generate new business opportunities through outbound calls, networking, and lead generation.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
- Identify hiring needs and promote solutions to businesses.
- Arrange meetings with key decision-makers to discuss HR requirements.
- Market high-quality candidates to prospective clients across a range of industries.
- Manage and grow client and prospect pipelines through CRM systems.
- Work towards and exceed weekly and monthly KPIs and revenue targets.
- Support business development campaigns and sales strategies.
- Prepare and deliver professional client presentations when required.
- Negotiate terms and secure new business agreements.
- Attend networking or client events to strengthen commercial relationships.

Experience and Skills Requirements:
- Previous sales, telesales, business development, or customer-facing experience preferred.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confident telephone manner with strong objection-handling ability.
- Target-driven with a competitive and motivated attitude.
- Organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Positive, energetic, and eager to progress your career.
- Interest in sales or business development.

If you are hungry for success, enjoy speaking with people, and want to build a rewarding career with excellent earning potential, apply today.

If you have not been contacted within 5 working days, then unfortunately on this occasion your CV has not been shortlisted.

title: IFA Client Service Associate
company: Premier Jobs UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A national IFA firm is hiring a Client Service Associate to work remotely across their central region, handling existing client onboarding, review meetings and new business processing. Paying £28,000 to £32,000, this role suits someone who thrives in a structured, task-based environment and wants the flexibility of fully remote working from day one.

Your purpose

You'll be part of their operational thread running through the advice process, ensuring existing clients move smoothly from review through to completion. Working across a central region covering substantial number of clients, you'll handle all the paperwork involved in ongoing cases and new business, picking up work from a centralized task list rather than supporting one dedicated planner. This requires a systematic style of working where accuracy and efficiency matter.

What the job involves
- Processing existing client onboarding across the central region
- Completing all review meeting documentation and follow-up
- Handling new business cases and ongoing client work
- Preparing Letters of Authority and ensuring data accuracy
- Working through structured task lists as cases come in
- Liaising with Financial Advisers and Paraplanners to ensure they have what they need

IFA Client Service Associate Requirements
- Essential: experience in an IFA administration role with strong client onboarding knowledge
- Essential: familiarity with Letters of Authority and the advice process
- Essential: comfortable working in a centralized team across multiple planners
- Desirable: experience using IO, Curo, Cashcalc or Dynamic Planner
- Desirable: based in Scotland, though candidates elsewhere will be considered for this fully remote role

About the business

This growing national firm is led by respected industry names and backed by private equity. On track to exceed £10 billion in assets under management and continuing acquisitions, they recognize that success depends on having the right people.

IFA Client Service Associate Benefits
- Salary of £28,000 to £32,000
- 37.5 hours per week, fully remote
- 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, rising by one day per year to 30 days
- 4x death in service, private medical insurance, group income protection
- Employee assistance programme, Medicash, 8% combined pension contribution
- Discretionary annual bonus

What happens next

Your application comes to Premier Jobs UK, we reply to every candidate either way, and where the experience fits we'll call to understand what you're looking for. Apply now for this remote Client Service Associate role and take the next step in your IFA career.

Premier Jobs UK Limited is acting as an employment agency for this permanent vacancy. Salary, benefits and on-target earnings are supplied by our client, may change, and form no part of any offer or contract. We give no warranty as to accuracy and accept no liability for reliance on this advert, except where liability cannot lawfully be excluded.
